title: Architecture without an architect
caption: North Window, Arches National Park, Moab, Utah
copyright: North Window, Arches National Park, Moab, Utah (© lightphoto/Getty Images)
description: On November 12, Arches National Park marks the anniversary of its designation as a national park in 1971. Just north of Moab, Utah, the high-desert park is home to more than 2,000 natural sandstone arches—the densest concentration of arches in the world. Today's image, North Window, is one of the best-known formations in the park's Windows Section, where towering fins, openings, and sculpted sandstone create a landscape that looks almost architectural.
